title: Hivestorm browser game component diagram
description: The browser side of Hivestorm: the engine, the page loop, the canvas UI, the high-score client and online play.

components.name: Hivestorm browser game
components.responsibility: Everything that runs in the browser.

components.name: Engine
components.responsibility: The Game class, its rules, its seeded generator and replay; no DOM.

components.name: UI
components.responsibility: Sprites and font, canvas drawing, controls and sound.

components.name: Page (main.ts)
components.responsibility: The 60 Hz loop, recording, the name form, online games taking turns, and the title and table screens.

components.name: Online play (online.ts)
components.responsibility: The match's WebSocket (Room) and the lockstep of every player's controls (Lockstep). Identical in Rally, Hivestorm and Shatterbelt.

components.name: High-score client (scores.ts)
components.responsibility: Seeds (tickets), submitting games and loading the table.

components.name: High-score Worker
components.responsibility: The server side of the table.

components.name: Games hub
components.responsibility: The games hub at icelander.net/games (the recreations repository's Worker): sign-in, /me, the multiplayer lobby and one WebSocket relay per online match.

relationships.description: Steps the Game and records each frame's Input.
Reads Controls, renders the Game and plays its events.
Joins the match in ?match=ID and plays it in lockstep.
Fetches a ticket ahead of each game, submits it and loads the table.
Draws a Game, produces its Input and sounds its events.
